newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary bombings continue, police at loss to solve.
newsitem.headline: Hungary bombings continue, police at loss to solve.

text.p: Hungarian police said a music club and restaurant in Budapest was set ablaze by petrol bombs early on Monday, four days after a handgrenade killed two people at another restaurant.
The fire bombing of the Greek restaurant comes amid a spate of similar attacks in the Hungarian capital that police have blamed on a gangland war they so far have been unable to stop.
